note: Invented people for a sandbox test run of the Seminar 2 group task and the EvoMentor homework. Every profile and behavior here was written by an AI. None of it comes from real students, and no expert in biology education has reviewed it. The misconception labels reuse the constructs named in the earlier synthetic batch (synth-jena-biologiedidaktik-2026-10-10) plus patterns that are widely discussed in evolution-education research; no citation was checked or added for this file. Use these personas to stress the tool and the task design. Do not treat their ratings or texts as evidence about how real students think.

personas.bio_background: Biologie-Leistungskurs, then a six-week student job in a human genetics lab doing PCR and gel runs. Strong in genetics, medium in ecology.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Reads the genetics Lernziele carefully and flags when a suggested link to Evolutive Entwicklung only works if you already assume selection is happening, which the Lernziel text never mentions.

personas.interest_note: Likes anything where a molecular mechanism explains something visible, such as blood groups or lactose tolerance.

group_preference.wants: Wants to be in a group with Mehmet because they already share notes for the genetics lecture.

personas.work_pattern: Works in two planned sessions, one on the weekend and one the evening before the deadline to tidy up.
personas.behavior_notes: Rates the genetics links low on fachliche Korrektheit whenever the tool links Mendel's rules to Evolutive Entwicklung without mentioning variation in a population, and writes a paragraph explaining why. She gives Beitrag zum eigenen Fachwissen a 1 almost every time because she already knows the content, which drags down her group's average and annoys the others. In the group she corrects other people's biology in front of everyone, which is accurate and makes two members stop talking. She spends so long on the first four Lernziele that she rushes the last three.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie at school, good marks in the zoology modules at university. Medium overall.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Accepts links between Angepasstheit Lernziele and Evolutive Entwicklung as obviously correct and paraphrases them as 'the animals developed this because they needed it in the cold', without noticing the explanation skips variation and selection.

personas.interest_note: Wants to teach animal adaptations to climate, because he thinks pupils find polar and desert animals easy to care about.

group_preference.wants: Wants to work with Johanna because she is thorough and they already know how to split work.

personas.work_pattern: Works in short bursts over several days, usually on the tram.
personas.behavior_notes: Completes every step and uploads on time. His ratings spread sensibly across the scale, but his written reasons for the Angepasstheit links repeat the 'because they needed it' phrasing, so his comments would mislead anyone reading them as a quality check. When Johanna points out the problem in the group he agrees quickly and then writes the same phrasing again in his homework. He picks Gesundheitserziehung as a cross-cutting theme for a polar-bear topic and cannot say why when asked.

personas.bio_background: Biology was not his strong subject at school; he chose it for the Sport combination. Weak.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Does not engage with the evolutionary side of any link at all and rates on whether the Lernziel sounds like something pupils would enjoy.

personas.interest_note: Interested in muscles, heart rate and nutrition because of his sport training.

group_preference.wants: Does not care who is in the group as long as the meeting time does not clash with training.

personas.work_pattern: Does everything in one session about two hours before the Moodle deadline.
personas.behavior_notes: Opens EvoMentor, notices it only offers the Gymnasium curriculum, and decides that is close enough instead of asking anyone. He picks three Lernziele from Klasse 7/8 on the heart and circulation, rates every link 3 or 4, and writes 'passt' or 'gut' as his reason. His upload is a screenshot with no text. He never notices the Regelschule Lernziele for his own topic are worded differently.

personas.bio_background: Leistungskurs Biologie with a good grade, mostly from memorising. Medium.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Describes animals in the behavior Lernziele as choosing strategies ('the bird decides to sing louder to win a female') and sees no problem when a link uses intentional language for non-human organisms.

personas.interest_note: Watches a lot of nature documentaries and likes animal behavior stories.

group_preference.wants: Hopes for a group that meets online because she commutes from Weimar.

personas.work_pattern: Does the homework in one evening, mostly by pasting the task into a chatbot and editing the result.
personas.behavior_notes: Pastes the Lernziel and the suggested Basiskonzept into a chatbot and asks it to justify the link, then copies the answer into her reason field. Her reasons are long, polished and nearly identical in structure, and they always agree with the tool, so almost everything gets a 4. Once the chatbot invents a Lernziel number that does not exist in the Thuringia curriculum, and she keeps it. In the group session she contributes little because her preparation is in a chat window she does not want to show.

personas.bio_background: Did a Bachelor's thesis-style project on field mapping of carabid beetles and volunteers for a bird-count group. Strong in ecology, weak in molecular topics.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Rates links that mention Konkurrenz highly and treats symbiosis or mutualism Lernziele as side cases, so she marks links between Symbiose and Evolutive Entwicklung as weak even when they are fine.

personas.interest_note: Wants pupils to go outside and count things in a hedge or a pond.

group_preference.wants: Wants a group that will pick an ecology topic and is happy to be outdoors.

personas.work_pattern: Works in short bursts over several days and keeps a running list in her phone.
personas.behavior_notes: Catches a real error where the tool links a food-chain Lernziel to Information und Kommunikation and gives it a 1 with a two-line explanation. She also gives low scores to two correct links on mutualism because she thinks cooperation is a minor topic, so her expert-looking ratings are only partly reliable. She is blunt and writes reasons like 'falsch' or 'kein Bezug' with no explanation for links outside ecology. She skips the cross-cutting themes entirely and writes 'BNE, offensichtlich'.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, passed the university modules on the second try for zoology. Weak to medium.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Explains links about Angepasstheit by saying the parents used a body part a lot and passed the stronger version on, and he rates links as correct when they fit this story.

personas.interest_note: Interested in dinosaurs and the history of how animals were classified.

group_preference.wants: Has no preference and will join whichever group has space.

personas.work_pattern: Starts early in the week, stops after twenty minutes, and finishes the night before.
personas.behavior_notes: Reads 'Verknüpfungen beurteilen' as rating the Lernziele themselves, so he scores whether each Lernziel is a good thing to teach and ignores the Basiskonzept link. When he sees EvoMentor only has the Gymnasium curriculum, he writes a long complaint in his upload that the tool is useless for Regelschule and then rates Gymnasium Lernziele anyway. His scores are spread out and look reasonable, which hides the fact that they answer a different question. In the group he is friendly and agrees with whoever speaks last.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, solid but uninterested in lab work. Medium.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Has no strong view and goes along with whatever the tool says about evolution.

personas.interest_note: Interested in vaccines and gut bacteria after reading a popular science book.

group_preference.wants: Wants to be with Maximilian because he usually organises everything.

personas.work_pattern: Waits until someone in the group shares their results, then does her own part in one short evening.
personas.behavior_notes: During the group session she nods along and takes photos of the whiteboard but does not suggest a single Lernziel. For the homework she copies the Lernziele her group already found and rates the same links, mostly 3s and 4s, with short reasons that paraphrase Maximilian's. She is friendly and good at making the group feel relaxed, which makes it hard for anyone to call her out. Her upload goes in on time and looks complete.

personas.bio_background: Leistungskurs Biologie and a confident speaker. Medium in content, strong in self-presentation.

evolution_views.construct: survival of the fittest as the strongest
evolution_views.how_it_shows: Reads fitness as physical strength or speed and rates links between Evolutive Entwicklung and predator-prey Lernziele as excellent, while calling links about reproduction or camouflage 'weak'.

personas.interest_note: Wants to teach a unit on predators because he thinks boys in Klasse 7 will finally pay attention.

group_preference.wants: Wants Sophie in the group because she is easy to work with and does not argue.

personas.work_pattern: Does a lot during the seminar itself and very little afterwards, usually one session the day before.
personas.behavior_notes: Picks the topic within five minutes and assigns grade bands to everyone before others have spoken. He rates harshly and with confidence, giving 1s to links he disagrees with, and some of his 1s are for correct links on sexual selection that do not fit his idea of strength. He pushes the group to choose Verhaltensbiologie even though two members wanted plants. His written reasons sound authoritative, so others in the group copy them.

personas.bio_background: Leistungskurs Biologie with top marks, enjoys cell biology lectures. Strong on facts, little practical experience.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Describes evolution in the curriculum links as a ladder from single cells to mammals to humans and rates links highly when the Lernziel lists organism groups in that order.

personas.interest_note: Fascinated by the origin of eukaryotic cells and endosymbiosis.

group_preference.wants: Wants a group that takes the task seriously and meets in person.

personas.work_pattern: Does the whole homework in one long Sunday session with a spreadsheet open.
personas.behavior_notes: Rates every link either 1 or 4 because she says a link is either correct or it is not, and refuses to use 2 or 3 even when the group asks her to. She is careful and complete, and she builds a neat table of all Lernziele across grades 5 to 10. Her comments describe Wirbeltierklassen Lernziele as showing 'how evolution developed higher animals', and she rates those links 4 across all three criteria. She is quiet in the group and only speaks when someone gets a fact wrong.

personas.bio_background: Trained as a medical laboratory technician before university and worked three years in a hospital microbiology lab. Strong in microbiology and cell biology.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Uses antibiotic resistance as her test case and checks whether the tool's links between bacteria Lernziele and Evolutive Entwicklung describe selection on existing variation correctly.

personas.interest_note: Wants pupils to understand why you finish an antibiotic course, from the bacteria's side.

group_preference.wants: Prefers to work alone because she works part time and cannot make group meetings.

personas.work_pattern: Works late at night after shifts, in two or three short sittings.
personas.behavior_notes: Notices immediately that EvoMentor has only the Gymnasium curriculum and emails Dr. Hanisch to ask whether she should use it anyway; she then rates the Gymnasium Lernziele and adds a note on which ones also appear in the Regelschule plan. She finds that one suggested link describes bacteria 'becoming resistant through contact with the antibiotic' and gives it a 1 with a precise correction. Her German has some grammar slips, and her reasons are short and dense. She is impatient with group members who have not prepared and says so.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, likes problems that have clear rules. Medium.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Treats every heredity Lernziel as a single-gene case and rates links that mention polygenic traits or environment as confusing or wrong.

personas.interest_note: Likes Kreuzungsschemata because they work like small logic puzzles.

group_preference.wants: Has no preference and suggests splitting work by grade band so nobody needs to meet again.

personas.work_pattern: Does the minimum in one short session and stops when the obvious parts are done.
personas.behavior_notes: Finds his Lernziele and rates fachliche Korrektheit for each link, then leaves Beitrag zum eigenen Fachwissen and didaktische Relevanz blank because he thinks they are optional. He never picks cross-cutting themes. His scores for the criterion he does fill in are reasonable apart from the heredity links, where he marks a correct link on Merkmalsausprägung and Umwelt as a 2. When the upload form complains about missing fields he puts 3 in every empty one.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, first year at university, has not yet taken ecology or genetics. Weak.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Assumes the tool must be right because it was made by the university and does not question any link.

personas.interest_note: Has a balcony full of herbs and wants to teach something about plants.

group_preference.wants: Hopes to land in a group with someone who knows what they are doing.

personas.work_pattern: Does the homework on her phone in one sitting during a break between rehearsals.
personas.behavior_notes: Rates nearly every link 4 on all three criteria and says she does not feel qualified to disagree. She stops after three Lernziele because she thinks that is enough. On the phone the rating table is hard to read, and she accidentally rates the same link twice. She is the youngest in her group and says almost nothing in the seminar.

personas.bio_background: Leistungskurs Biologie, reads widely on bioethics, good grades in human biology. Medium to strong.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Reads heredity and human biology Lernziele as 'the genes decide who you are' and marks links that bring in environment or lifestyle as fachlich weak.

personas.interest_note: Wants to teach genetic testing and designer-baby debates in Klasse 9/10.

group_preference.wants: Wants a group open to an ethics angle on genetics.

personas.work_pattern: Works steadily over a week, one Lernziel at a time, and rereads before uploading.
personas.behavior_notes: Gives mostly 1s and 2s and justifies each one at length, often on didaktische Relevanz, which he judges by whether a link would support an ethics debate. His strictness on fachliche Korrektheit is unevenly placed: he punishes correct links about gene-environment interaction and lets through a link that overstates what a single gene does. He picks Demokratiebildung as his cross-cutting theme and writes a convincing paragraph about it. He finishes early and offers to proofread others' texts, which some people find helpful and others find patronising.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, enjoys the didactics courses more than the science courses. Weak to medium.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Rewrites links in her own words as 'plants grow thorns so they will not be eaten' and sees the purpose-based version as clearer for pupils.

personas.interest_note: Interested in the forest dieback near her hometown in the Thüringer Wald.

group_preference.wants: Wants a group with at least one other Regelschule person.

personas.work_pattern: Does it in one evening, using a chatbot to draft the reasons and then shortening them.
personas.behavior_notes: When she sees only the Gymnasium curriculum in EvoMentor she asks a chatbot to 'convert' the Lernziele to Regelschule level and rates the converted versions, which no longer match any Lernziel in the tool. Her reasons are tidy and generic, and they mostly agree with the tool with 3s and 4s. She takes Sprachbildung seriously and writes a good note on how the Lernziel wording could be simplified for her pupils. She does not mention in her upload that a chatbot produced most of the text.

personas.bio_background: Leistungskurs Biologie, worked as a tutor for the human physiology module and coaches a youth swim team. Strong in human physiology.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: When a link connects a hormone or nerve Lernziel to Evolutive Entwicklung, he answers the 'why' with the mechanism (adrenaline raises heart rate) and does not see that the link asks for the evolutionary reason.

personas.interest_note: Wants to teach stress and the fight-or-flight response using pupils' own pulse measurements.

group_preference.wants: Wants a group that will pick a human biology topic.

personas.work_pattern: Does the homework in two evenings after training, with long breaks in between.
personas.behavior_notes: Spots a physiology error in one suggested link and rates it 1 with a clear correction. He also gives a 1 to a correct link between Hormonsystem and Evolutive Entwicklung because he thinks the hormone mechanism already fully explains the behavior, and he argues this firmly in the group. His physiology corrections are accurate, so people trust him on the evolutionary point too. He is helpful to weaker group members and explains things patiently, but he takes over the human biology part without asking.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, solid grades. Medium.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Reads the developmental biology links with reasonable care and has no strong evolutionary framing either way.

personas.interest_note: Interested in how a frog or a chicken develops from a single cell.

group_preference.wants: Has no preference.

personas.work_pattern: Starts with good intentions, then disappears for a week and comes back right before the deadline.
personas.behavior_notes: Joins the group in Seminar 2 and takes the 9/10 grade band, then stops answering in the group chat for eight days because of a family situation she does not explain. The group has to cover her grade band without her. She does her own EvoMentor homework late and alone, with sensible balanced ratings on developmental biology Lernziele that do not match the group's chosen topic. Her upload is fine on its own and makes no sense next to the group's.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, very organised, keeps fish and a small aquarium. Medium.

evolution_views.construct: survival of the fittest as the strongest
evolution_views.how_it_shows: Explains selection in the fish and bird Lernziele as 'the strongest survive' and rates links that mention reproduction success as a bit off-topic.

personas.interest_note: Wants to use her aquarium to show pupils fish behavior in class.

group_preference.wants: Wants to work with Pascal because they are both Regelschule and live in the same student house.

personas.work_pattern: Works a little every day and checks things off a printed list.
personas.behavior_notes: Notices that EvoMentor only shows the Gymnasium curriculum and spends half an hour matching each Gymnasium Lernziel to the closest Regelschule one in the PDF before rating. Her ratings are spread across the scale and mostly sensible. The 'strongest survive' idea shows up in three of her reasons, including one where she lowers a correct link on Fortpflanzung. She ends up doing part of Pascal's work for him without complaining.

personas.bio_background: Did Biologie as a Grundkurs and remembers little of it. Weak.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Does not bring any evolutionary reasoning to the links and rates by gut feeling.

personas.interest_note: Interested in nutrition and doping because of his fitness hobby.

group_preference.wants: Wants to be with Anh because she keeps track of deadlines.

personas.work_pattern: Does everything in one late evening session, often after midnight.
personas.behavior_notes: Rates links only 1 or 4 because he finds the middle options pointless, deciding mainly by whether the Lernziel sounds interesting. He sees that EvoMentor has no Regelschule curriculum, writes 'gibts nich für RS' in his upload, and rates two Gymnasium Lernziele anyway. His reasons are two or three words with typos. He asks Anh the next day what Basiskonzepte are.

personas.bio_background: Leistungskurs Biologie, took an elective on primate behavior. Medium to strong in behavior.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Writes that animals in the Lernziele 'want to pass on their genes' and treats that as the scientific explanation, while saying humans are the only ones who truly decide.

personas.interest_note: Interested in cooperation in primates and whether it compares to human morality.

group_preference.wants: Wants a group interested in behavior and ethics.

personas.work_pattern: Works in one long session the weekend before the deadline.
personas.behavior_notes: Thinks the homework asks her to propose her own Basiskonzept links, so she ignores the tool's suggestions and writes new links of her own, then rates her own links. Where she does look at the tool's links she is harsh, giving 1s and 2s, often because the link 'ignores the animal's motivation'. Her texts are long and well written, which makes the misreading harder to spot. She is irritated when told she did the wrong task and asks whether she has to redo it.

personas.bio_background: Worked as a student assistant in the botanical garden for two years and identifies plants by family on sight. Strong in botany.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Checks plant Lernziele against his own field knowledge and notices when a link to Evolutive Entwicklung uses an animal example where a plant one would fit better.

personas.interest_note: Wants pupils to learn ten local plant families properly by Klasse 6.

group_preference.wants: Has no preference but would like a group that is fine with a plant topic.

personas.work_pattern: Does the homework in one focused morning session.
personas.behavior_notes: Finds that the tool links Fotosynthese to Stoff- und Energieumwandlung correctly and also to Information und Kommunikation for no clear reason, and he rates the second link 1 with one sharp sentence. He is dismissive about Lernziele outside botany and rates their didaktische Relevanz low without much thought. He is reliable and finishes everything, and he makes fun of the zoology-heavy topic list in the group chat. He refuses to use the word 'Basiskonzept' in his own writing because he finds it vague.

personas.bio_background: Leistungskurs Biologie and Chemie, careful lab worker, good grades. Medium to strong.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: In climate-adaptation Lernziele she reasons that animals exposed to heat over generations 'get used to it and pass it on', and rates links phrased that way as correct.

personas.interest_note: Wants to teach climate change and species shifts in Klasse 9/10.

group_preference.wants: Wants a group that will take BNE seriously.

personas.work_pattern: Works over three evenings and drafts her reasons in a Word file first.
personas.behavior_notes: Completes every step carefully and on time, with good notes on BNE. She rates most links 3 or 4 and only drops to 2 when a link seems clearly unrelated. Her Lamarckian reasoning appears in her own reason texts and nobody in her group notices, because she is otherwise strong and confident. She is generous in group work and shares her Word file with everyone.

personas.bio_background: Did a vocational training as a brewer before studying and knows yeast fermentation well. Medium overall, strong on fermentation.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Focuses on whether the link is practical for a lesson and does not engage with the evolutionary claims.

personas.interest_note: Wants to brew something with pupils to teach fermentation.

group_preference.wants: Prefers to work alone because he finds group meetings slow.

personas.work_pattern: Does the work in one short session and leaves whatever he does not understand.
personas.behavior_notes: Skips the account step by using a group member's login, which mixes his ratings into her account. He sees the tool only has the Gymnasium curriculum, decides it is 'close enough for fermentation', and moves on without comment. He rates only 1 or 4 and skips the didaktische Relevanz column for most links. He skips the cross-cutting themes and the upload has no reasons at all.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, very good in the ecology modules, active in a local environmental group. Medium.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Explains all biotic interactions in the Lernziele as a fight over resources and reads the tool's links on symbiosis as exceptions to the rule.

personas.interest_note: Interested in invasive species and why some newcomers take over a habitat.

group_preference.wants: Has no preference and is happy to moderate if nobody else does.

personas.work_pattern: Works in short bursts over several days and keeps adding to the same document.
personas.behavior_notes: Does the full task and writes long, thoughtful reasons with some typos. Her ratings are mostly fair, but she keeps steering the group's topic toward competition and invasive species and describes cooperation Lernziele as 'nice to have'. She moderates the group discussion well and makes sure the quieter members get a turn. She runs out of time on the cross-cutting themes and copies the list from the slide.

personas.bio_background: Leistungskurs Biologie, first year at university, strong in exams and impatient with writing. Medium.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Has no strong evolutionary framing and lets the chatbot decide what to say about each link.

personas.interest_note: Likes microscopy and wants pupils to build cell models.

group_preference.wants: Wants to be in a group with Greta because they went to the same school.

personas.work_pattern: Does it in one evening while doing other homework in parallel.
personas.behavior_notes: Chooses his own ratings, which are spread across the scale and roughly sensible, and then asks a chatbot to write the reasons for whatever number he picked. The reasons sometimes argue for a different score than the one he gave. He shortens them to two sentences each, so the copying is less obvious. In the group he is helpful with finding Lernziele quickly but avoids writing anything on the shared board.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, first year, keen and careful. Weak to medium.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Describes the vertebrate Lernziele as fish coming first, then 'more developed' amphibians and reptiles, and sees mammals as the most evolved.

personas.interest_note: Interested in fossils and the move of animals from water to land.

group_preference.wants: Wants to work with Julian because she knows him from school.

personas.work_pattern: Works over several days and asks the group chat whenever she is unsure.
personas.behavior_notes: Does every step, including cross-cutting themes, and uploads early. She rates almost every link 4 because she assumes the tool knows more than she does, and her reasons mostly restate the link. Her comments on the Wirbeltiere Lernziele use 'höher entwickelt' several times. She is anxious about doing it wrong and sends the group chat four questions about the rating scale.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, passes modules with average grades. Medium to weak.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Assumes eye color, height and intelligence each come from one gene and rates heredity links as correct when they fit that picture.

personas.interest_note: Interested in inherited diseases because a relative has one.

group_preference.wants: Has no preference.

personas.work_pattern: Waits for the group's shared document, then does his part in about thirty minutes.
personas.behavior_notes: Arrives late to Seminar 2 and lets the others pick the topic and Lernziele. For the homework he takes the group's list, rates the same links mostly 3 and 4, and writes short reasons full of typos. When he sees the tool has only the Gymnasium curriculum he says in the group chat that this means the task 'does not count' for Regelschule people, which nobody confirms. He contributes one useful point about a family experience with Mukoviszidose and then goes quiet again.

personas.bio_background: Leistungskurs Biologie, did a research internship in a developmental genetics lab working with zebrafish embryos. Strong in developmental and molecular biology.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Checks whether the links between Individuelle Entwicklung and Evolutive Entwicklung keep the two levels apart, and objects when the tool blurs development of one organism with evolution of a lineage.

personas.interest_note: Wants to show pupils how small changes in developmental genes can change body plans.

group_preference.wants: Prefers to work alone because she is writing her thesis and wants to set her own schedule.

personas.work_pattern: Does the work in one long evening and goes over it again the next morning.
personas.behavior_notes: Writes the most precise ratings in the cohort and catches two links where the tool treats Metamorphose as an example of evolution. She also rates the didaktische Relevanz of several correct links low because they would be 'too simple for Klasse 9', which is a judgment about pupils she has never taught. Her reasons are long and include a lot of technical vocabulary that nobody else in the seminar uses. She skips the group phase as far as she can and hands in a separate topic.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, studying while raising a young child. Medium.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Reads Lernziele about behavior and appearance as fixed by genes and rates links that mention learning or environment as fachlich doubtful.

personas.interest_note: Interested in dog breeds and how breeding shaped them.

group_preference.wants: Wants a group that does as much as possible during the seminar so she has less to do at home.

personas.work_pattern: Does the homework in fifteen minutes during her child's nap.
personas.behavior_notes: Rates only the three Lernziele she found in class and gives mostly 1s and 2s with no explanation. When she sees the tool lacks the Regelschule curriculum she writes one line in her upload saying the tool does not fit her school type and stops there. Her strictness comes from being tired and sceptical of the tool more than from any subject reasoning. She is direct and efficient in the group and pushes to finish early.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, came to Jena from Italy for school and studies; good at physics and medium in biology.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: When a link asks why a structure evolved, he explains how it works (how the lens focuses light) and counts that as the evolutionary answer.

personas.interest_note: Interested in the eye and the senses because they connect to his physics optics course.

group_preference.wants: Has no preference.

personas.work_pattern: Works in two sessions and spends most of the first one exploring the tool's other features.
personas.behavior_notes: Opens the AI prompt generator in EvoMentor and thinks the homework is to produce a lesson plan, so he spends an hour generating one on the eye. He then rates the Basiskonzept links in a hurry, with fair scores spread across the scale. His reasons for the Evolutive Entwicklung links describe the mechanism of seeing and never mention selection. He uploads the lesson plan instead of the ratings table and only notices after the deadline.

personas.bio_background: Grundkurs Biologie, competent but has lost interest in the subject during her studies. Medium.

evolution_views.how_it_shows: Reads the links quickly and rates them without bringing any evolutionary view, correct or otherwise.

personas.interest_note: Interested in medicinal plants and their history in monastery gardens.

group_preference.wants: Has no preference and is mainly hoping for a group that does not schedule extra meetings.

personas.work_pattern: Does everything in one late evening session.
personas.behavior_notes: Does exactly the minimum: three Lernziele, one rating per criterion, one sentence each. Her ratings are spread sensibly and she occasionally spots a weak link, but she never explains why in more than a few words. She is more interested in her history seminar and says so in the group. She suggests Kulturelle Bildung as a cross-cutting theme for her monastery-garden idea, which is the one creative contribution in her group.
